name: Supplier Payment Inquiries
description: Automatically handles supplier questions about payment status, invoice approvals, and remittance details.

workflow_steps.description: Supplier sends an email inquiring about payment status, invoice approval, or remittance details.
AI reads the email, classifies the intent, extracts the invoice reference, and queries the ERP system.
If the invoice is found and payment is scheduled with high confidence, the AI replies automatically with payment details.
If the invoice is on hold, amount exceeds $25,000, or confidence is low, escalate to the AP Manager via Slack.
workflow_steps.what_action_is_expected: Review and respond within 1 business day

participants.description: Automated by the digital worker — reviews ERP data and generates responses
Reviews escalated cases: on-hold invoices, high-value invoices over $25,000, and low-confidence classifications

policies.trigger: Always notify the AP Manager when invoice amount exceeds $25,000, even if auto-response is possible
Never auto-respond to invoices with status 'on_hold' — always escalate to AP Manager for review
Escalate to AP Manager if classification confidence is below 85%
Never auto-respond to invoice approval requests — all INVOICE_APPROVAL intents require human sign-off from an AP Manager before any action is taken

templates.name: Payment Status Response
templates.content:
Dear [Supplier Name],

Thank you for reaching out regarding invoice [Invoice Number].

We have reviewed your inquiry and can confirm that payment of [Amount] is [scheduled for / was processed on] [Payment Date] via [Payment Method].

If you have any additional questions or need further details, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Best regards,
Accounts Payable Team
